summary: Search the web and read a page's text through Tavily. Needs TAVILY_API_KEY in .env.

tools.name: tool_web_search
tools.purpose: Search the web; returns titles, addresses and snippets.

tools.name: tool_web_readPage
tools.purpose: Read the text of one web page.

params.name: query
params.description: What to search for, as a plain search query.

params.name: max_results
params.description: How many results to return (1 to 10).

params.name: topic
params.description: news for recent events, else general.

params.name: url
params.description: The full http:// or https:// address.

workflow.explanation: Read the best one or two pages.
